# jobkit

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/kit/jobkit"
```

Package jobkit is what framework/kit/jobs plugs into kit: the scheduler kit's jobs run on — the SDK's scheduler, on the app's clock — and the schedules it reads from a job's declaration, a period or a five-field cron expression (ADR 0179 §1, step 7). kit's core imports none of the SDK's scheduler: it reaches it through plug, and a product that declares no job links none of it.

Package jobkit — the compile-time proof that the scheduler is kit's.
